title: Kenyan Stilton Fried Rice
description: A flavorful fried rice dish infused with the bold flavors of Kenya and the creaminess of stilton cheese. This gluten-free recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the scrambled eggs to the skillet and cook until set, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked fried rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the Kenyan stews zesty sauce, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and top with crumbled Stilton cheese and chopped green onions.
